findings.where: packages/runtime/tests/intake-admission-e2e.mjs:241-271 (leg 1), cf. packages/runtime/tests/relay-fixtures.mjs:250-292 (ensureClassifyConsent) and packages/runtime/tests/classify-consumer.test.mjs:38-49 (seedClassifiable); brief-633.md:172 ("upload -> ocr done -> classify -> invoice facts -> admit_autodraft_task with zero request_autodraft calls"); reports/633-final.md AC4 row ("World e2e legs 1-2: admitted coding task with zero request_autodraft in the automatic lane")
findings.what: Leg 1 of the new real-Postgres-World e2e -- the one deliverable the brief and AC4/AC10 actually demand ("the chain reaches an admitted coding task on its own", per the test's own header comment) -- never gets past 'a classify task exists'. Its poll predicate is `(row) => row !== null`, which ignores `status`, so it passes even when the classify task is immediately, permanently gated. On this rig it always is: an UNFILED document (leg 1 never calls fileToClient/record_client_resolution) routes classify's enqueue-time consent gate (0123_f_a7_gamma_egress.sql:1420-1436) into the 'zero active filings' branch, which requires the firm-narrow `firm_narrow_intake`/`attribution` consent to be activated -- and nothing in this file or in packages/runtime/tests/rig.mjs's `buildFirm` ever activates it. The sibling DB-level test (classify-consumer.test.mjs's `seedClassifiable`) knows this precisely and works around it by filing the document to a client and calling `ensureClassifyConsent` first, with an explicit comment naming 0123's gate; intake-admission-e2e.mjs does neither. Consequence: invoice facts are never enqueued and `admit_autodraft_task` is never called for this journey, so the ticket's central AC4/AC10 claim -- 'a file becomes admitted WORK with no human pressing anything, proven on a real Postgres World' -- is unproven, and the final report's AC4 evidence line ('admitted coding task') does not hold. This is not a named residual anywhere in the report's Assumptions/Unverified/Follow-ups sections; it is an undisclosed gap between the claimed and actual evidence. Because the CI step in `.github/actions/db-live-gates/action.yml` just invokes this same file, CI will report the step green without ever validating the claim either.
findings.evidence: Ran (rig clara_633, PG 127.0.0.1:55502): `cd packages/runtime && node tests/intake-admission-e2e.mjs` twice, both `exit 0`, both printing `[leg 1] PASS -- ingest done, classify enqueued (failed), zero request_autodraft in the automatic lane` (status is literally 'failed', not 'done'). Direct DB query on clara_633 after the runs: `select status, error_code, count(*) from clara.document_processing_tasks where lane='classify' group by 1,2` -> 69 rows `status=failed, error_code=firm_narrow_consent_inactive`, 0 rows `done`; `select count(*) from clara.domain_events where event_type='document.classified'` -> 0 (across the whole session, every DB battery included); `select count(*) from clara.document_processing_tasks where lane='invoice_facts'` -> 3 total, none traceable to this e2e's documents. `select ... from clara.firm_egress_purpose_activations` confirms the `firm_narrow_intake`/`attribution` consent mechanism exists and is exercised elsewhere (9 rows from other DB fixtures) but is never granted by `rig.buildFirm` or by this file. packages/runtime/README.md's own #633 section (written by the same worker) already describes leg 1 more narrowly as 'upload -> ocr done -> classify enqueued' -- omitting 'invoice facts -> admit_autodraft_task' that the in-file header comment (line 20, 24) and the final report both claim.
findings.fix: Before leg 1's upload, seed the firm-narrow `firm_narrow_intake`/`attribution` consent for the test firm (add a runtime-side helper mirroring `ensureClassifyConsent`'s grant/activate calls but for `clara.grant_firm_egress_purpose`/`activate_firm_egress_purpose` at moment='attribution'), or file the leg-1 document to `client` and reuse `ensureClassifyConsent` the way `classify-consumer.test.mjs`'s `seedClassifiable` does. Strengthen the leg-1 poll to require `status === 'done'` (not merely non-null) and a non-null `document_kind`, then add polls for an enqueued+settled `invoice_facts` task and for the actual coding/autodraft admission (whatever `admit_autodraft_task`'s receipt or the resulting `accounting_work`/coding-attempt row is) before printing PASS. Until that lands, rewrite the leg's log line, the file's header comment, and the report's AC4 row to say what is actually proven ('classify enqueued, gated by a still-inactive firm-narrow consent') and name the invoice-facts/admit_autodraft_task gap as a residual rather than asserting it as delivered.
